title: Consider the Consequences!

description.en: Three intertwined lives. Choices about love, work and family lead to different consequences.
description.ja: 恋愛、仕事、家族についての選択が、交差する3人の人生を異なる結末へ導く分岐物語。

rights.note: Wikisource identifies the original 1930 work as public domain in the United States. This is not a worldwide rights clearance. Retain source contributors, revision links and applicable license notices.

attribution: This interactive adaptation is based on Consider the Consequences! (1930) by Doris Webster and Mary Alden Hopkins. Transcription source: English Wikisource and its contributors. The narration is translated at play time by the selected voice agent; it is not an official published translation.
content_notice: The original contains dated social attitudes and may include death, violence and suicide. These belong to the fictional work, not to advice for the player.
